title: Benchmarking a database query
intro:
Illustrative data, made up for this book. A query was timed 16 times after a warm-up: mean 182.4 ms, standard deviation 9.6 ms.

Give the 95 % interval for the mean query time (lower and upper, two decimals) and its margin of error (two decimals).

In the Workbench: **Confidence interval**, **Target** *Mean, σ unknown (t)*, **Data from** *Summary statistics entered here*.

MarginOfError.says: That uses z = 1.96. With σ estimated from 16 runs, use t with 15 degrees of freedom (2.131).
